the concept of offspring selection can be used to increase the potential of Genetic Algorithms (and Genetic Programming) in the sense of a more efficient maintenance of the genetic information stored in the population.

the concept of offspring selection, which is an offspring selection strategy that is not based on fitness values, allows a more efficient preservation of the relevant genetic information in a population.

the offspring selection is an efficient and effective algorithmic concept for maintaining the relevant genetic information in a population, which allows to achieve better results on the basis of the well known benchmark problems than the standard selection strategy of GAs and the tournament selection of GP.

the development of a general framework for the design and analysis of evolutionary algorithms that is based on the concepts of natural evolution and that can be applied to a wide range of optimization problems.
